function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web via Exa or Parallel. Returns bounded results with provider, title, URL, and concise context; does not fetch full pages.

max_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, maximum 20).

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Fetch readable public http(s) text. Network resource ceiling 8 MiB; model-facing text is fitted by runtime context admission. Default discovery excerpt is 4096 characters (not a capacity ceiling); length can explicitly select more. Use artifact_id and offset for retained continuation without another download. For mixed Vision research keep early text focused: full-history Vision context is 8192 expanded positions. Supply exactly one of url or artifact_id. Private/local URLs and redirects are refused.

function.name: fetch_image
function.description: Acquire a public PNG/JPEG/WebP without transformation and view it with Vision. Retains original bytes; artifact_id reuses a completed acquisition. Shares the full-history Vision envelope.

function.name: fetch_pdf
function.description: Read a public PDF or additional pages from retained artifact_id without another download. Defaults to page 1. auto uses selected text layers and Vision for scans/figures/tables; text forces text; visual renders selected pages. No whole-document context injection or active PDF execution.

offset.description: Character offset in each selected text page, for retained text continuation.

messages.content: Use fetch_image to inspect https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/explore/main/topics/python/python.png and describe the actual colors and shapes briefly.
I'll fetch and inspect that image.

The image is the Python logo on a white/transparent background, 288×288 px.

**Colors:** Two interlocking snake shapes — the upper-left one in a blue gradient (darker steel-blue at the top-left edge, lightening toward a softer mid-blue), and the lower-right one in a yellow-to-gold gradient (brighter yellow at the top-right, deepening to a warmer gold/amber toward the bottom). A thin white gap outlines each shape where they meet, separating them.

**Shapes:** Two mirrored, thick-banded forms that curve like stylized snakes. Each has a rounded head with a short snout, a small white circular "eye" dot, and a body that bends 90° and tapers into a rounded tail that interlocks with the other. Together they form a roughly square, pinwheel-like composition — the blue snake facing left/up, the yellow one facing right/down, offset diagonally.
